source_differences: Record point (46.4965, 13.71314) is Rateče settlement centre, identical to ratece_cable, the Nordic Centre is ~2.5 km south (Wikipedia 46.4758, 13.7240).
Client name: record 'Zavod za šport RS Planica', Wikipedia operator 'ZŠRS Planica', remontees 'Nordijski Center Planica' (same body, naming only).
open_question: the record does not name the lift. Position: placed on the chairlift mapped at the Planica Nordic Centre (OpenStreetMap way 373928812, named Sedežnica, read 12 November 2026). It is about 420 m long in plan, against 434 m horizontal length in the report on the Čaplja chairlift, which "provides access to almost all the ski jumps in the Planica Nordic Centre". The ZAG reference list does not name the lift, so the link to this lift is an inference. The point is the lower station.
